intro: Describe the diagram in Mermaid-like text. Rhumb draws it as a block diagram that follows the selected standard.

syntax.title: Structure
syntax.header: Start with flowchart (or graph) and a direction: TD, TB, BT, LR or RL.
syntax.chain: Connect blocks with arrows. Chains work: A --> B --> C.
syntax.label: Label a line with |text| or -- text -->.
syntax.comment: Lines that start with %% are comments.

shapes.title: Blocks by name and their extras
shapes.text: Any block can also be written as A@{ shape: name, label: "text" } with the shape names Mermaid uses (doc, sl-rect, trap-t, fork, ...); Rhumb adds seq-store, loop-start and loop-end. The same braces carry properties of a block. In the short forms, put the text in quotes to keep it from being read as part of the form.

extras.ident: Identifier above the block, on the left
extras.desc: Description above the block, on the right
extras.input: Description below the block, on the right
extras.ref: Stripe that points to a detailed sheet
extras.loop: Name that joins the two loop limits
extras.side: Side of a comment: right, left, top or bottom
extras.legend: What the letter of a transfer stands for, shown under the diagram

structure.title: Frames, comments and omissions
structure.text: A frame is a dashed outline around blocks. A comment is tied to a block or a frame with a dashed line and always stands beside it. Loop limits are paired by the name before the colon. A line labelled with three dots shows that blocks are left out. A line labelled with a tilde carries the zigzag of a communication link.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.text: Label the branches Yes and No. The profile decides which side each one leaves from; unlabeled branches use the free sides in order. Where the profile leaves the side open, a branch that goes back to a preparation block leaves on the side that block takes returning lines on.

preparation.title: Returning to a preparation block
preparation.text: When the flow comes back to a preparation block, the line into the repeated section leaves from the bottom, returning lines enter one side corner and the other lines leave from the opposite one.

standards.title: Standards
standards.text: A standard is a JSON profile with block sizes, line widths, fonts and branch sides. Pick a built-in one on the Config tab or load your own.
